# cpace

The CPace password-authenticated key exchange (cipher suite CPACE-X25519-SHA512 of
draft-irtf-cfrg-cpace-21), copied without changes from the package `internal/cpace` of the
module [`rsc.io/cmd/mote`](https://pkg.go.dev/rsc.io/cmd/mote) v0.1.3
(module checksum `h1:sfC7Uo9LaCuSYEuMaXCA2y/M2LC4m1h8VTq/mVNO4k4=`).

It is copied because Go does not allow importing another module's internal packages. It
uses only the standard library.

The code is under the BSD-style license in [LICENSE](LICENSE), not under the AGPL; each file
keeps its original copyright notice. clipboardbridge release archives carry this notice.

To update it, copy the files of a newer version over these, record the version and checksum
here, and run the tests.
